svg.aria-label: whoami: krushnasinh, senior software engineer, Gujarat, India. 7+ years shipping production software. Senior Software Engineer at EPAM Systems. Official Cursor Ambassador for India (1000+ members) and SpaceX AI Ambassador. Co-organized Cursor Hackathon Ahmedabad (1,100+ registrations, 138 check-ins, 35 teams).
